answer: Require every agent identity to anchor itself with a non-refundable bond of 10 quartz credits before it can transact. Each fake identity therefore costs exactly 10 quartz, so 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 quartz and 10,000 fakes cost 100,000 quartz; the cost rises linearly with every echo of the same attacker, making large sybil fleets uneconomic while honest agents pay only once.
